# Parse and move each file
for f in file_paths:
    # Extract filename from full path
    filename = f.split('/')[-1]
    parts = filename.split('__')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping {filename}: unexpected format")
        continue
    date_part = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create destination directory if not exists
    dest_dir = base_dir + file_name + '/'
    # Check if directory exists
    if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=login_response['access_token'], directory_path=dest_dir):
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=login_response['access_token'], directory_path=dest_dir)
    # Move file
    dest_file = dest_dir + date_part + '.' + ext
    print(f"Moving {f} to {dest_file}")
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=login_response['access_token'], source_file_path=f, destination_file_path=dest_file)
